fact: A convention between the Gabonese State and BEAC makes the Madigipaie GIMAC QR-code payment system conform to community technical norms on interoperability, with BEAC guaranteeing the QR transactions (minister's statement, 3 July 2026).
title: Gabon/Numérique : le programme Madigipaie présenté à l'édile de Libreville
